answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 688 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. The tundra index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the hollow queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. That is 14 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
